rows.name: The Venetian Resort
rows.address_note: The official resort map (venetianlasvegas.com) shows the Venetian/Palazzo complex between Sands Avenue and Las Vegas Blvd with the poker room on level 2 of the Grand Canal Shoppes. No official page read in this session prints the street address, so it is left blank.
rows.resort_fee_note: Official hotel terms: "The Venetian Resort has a standard Las Vegas Resort Fee of $55 plus applicable tax per night, payable upon check-in."
rows.tax_note: Official hotel terms: "Daily rates do not include the applicable Clark County Room Tax of 13.38%."
rows.room_rate_note: Official poker suite page: suite rates "will start as low as $119 and $209 and can be higher", conditional on qualifying poker play (6 hours of live cash play or a $300+ tournament buy-in per night) and on availability; book by calling 866.255.8936 with code EPOKR25. The page does not say which rate applies to which tower or date. Logged official booking-engine quote on 2026-11-17 for Nov 18-20 (2 adults): room charges $204.25 and $524.25 a night, $55.00 resort fee each night, taxes $112.19, total $950.69 (see data/rates.json). It is not copied into room_rate_usd because the rate changes by night.
rows.parking_note: Official hotel terms: "The daily fee for registered hotel guests is $20/day, seven days a week. For non-hotel guests, the fee is $20, Monday - Thursday, and $25/day Friday - Sunday. Valet parking is $40/day." Official poker page: players who play three hours or more get complimentary self-parking.
rows.cancellation_note: Official hotel terms: "A deposit for your stay, including suite, fee, and tax, will be billed upon reservation confirmation." "Check-out prior to your scheduled departure date will result in an additional charge of $100 plus tax." Prepaid offers are non-cancellable and non-refundable. A fixed free-cancellation deadline is not published for general rates.
rows.check_in_out: Check-in 3:00 p.m. - 11:59 p.m.; check-out 11:00 a.m. (official hotel terms)
rows.walk_note: The poker room is inside the Venetian/Palazzo complex (The Palazzo, level 2, Grand Canal Shoppes), so no street walking is needed; the published walking time for the outside legs is blank because no official source publishes it.
rows.true_cost_note: Taken from the official booking engine quote in data/rates.json: 2027-01-01 to 2027-01-06, 5 nights, checkout total $4,559.30, i.e. $911.86 per night after room, resort fee and tax.

rows.name: Wynn Las Vegas
rows.address: 3131 Las Vegas Blvd. S., Las Vegas, NV 89109
rows.address_note: Official Wynn Las Vegas facts page (ai-information, last updated November 2026).
rows.resort_fee_note: Official Wynn offer terms: "A daily resort fee of $55 plus tax will be added to your room account for each room night". Official Wynn facts page repeats $55 plus tax for Resort and Tower Suites.
rows.tax_note: No Wynn room-tax rate is printed on any official Wynn page, and the official Wynn booking engine (reservations.wynnlasvegas.com) returns only its fee and policy text to a text fetch - it renders the nightly rate grid and the tax line client-side, so no Wynn quote with a tax figure could be captured on 2026-11-17. The Venetian's 13.38% Clark County rate is therefore NOT applied to Wynn here.
rows.room_rate_note: No nightly rate is published on an official Wynn page. Use the official booking engine. Re-checked 2026-11-17: the engine again ignored the requested date parameters (asked for Nov 18-20; it rendered a 1-night stay of Nov 16-17) and exposes no tax or checkout total to a text fetch, so no Wynn quote is logged. Two offer averages appeared for the rendered stay only: $1,254 (Flexible Getaway) and $1,074 (Your Fall to Have It All) per night, each including the resort fee and excluding taxes.
rows.parking_note: Official Wynn facts page: "Self-parking for nonregistered guests is $25 per day, with the first three hours complimentary. Valet parking is $40 for up to 24 hours... Registered Resort and Tower Suites guests receive complimentary self-parking." Official offer terms and the official booking engine (read 2026-11-17) add complimentary self-parking for up to two vehicles. A hotel stay's parking cost is therefore $0 self-park; the $25 figure is the non-registered-guest rate and is kept here so the two are never conflated.
rows.cancellation_note: Official Wynn offer terms (special offer): "a deposit of one (1) night of room and tax for each room booked under this offer will be charged at the time of booking and cancellations must be received at least 48 hours prior to arrival date or deposit will be forfeited." Official facts page: "Deposit requirements, cancellation deadlines, and penalties vary by offer and travel dates."
rows.check_in_out: Check-in 3 p.m.; check-out at noon (official Wynn facts page)
rows.walk_note: The poker room is at Encore, part of the Wynn Las Vegas resort (official WPT and daily tournament terms: "Players will register in the Wynn Las Vegas Poker Room, located in Encore at Wynn Las Vegas"), so the walk is inside the resort. The cross-property walk from Wynn/Encore to the Venetian is not published by any official source and is left blank.
rows.true_cost_note: No rate confirmed for a specific stay date set.

rows.resort_fee_note: Official Bellagio Hotel Reservation Terms and Conditions: "Daily Resort Fee. A daily resort fee of $55.00 plus applicable tax will be applied to all reservations." The same page lists what the fee covers and states the fee is waived for MGM Rewards Gold+ members on eligible reservations. Read 2026-11-17.

The Bellagio terms print the tax rule but not a percentage: "Lodging taxes apply to the basic room rate, any resort fee, additional per occupant charges, upgrades, as well as any other charges as required by applicable law." A published MGM offer for a Bellagio/ARIA stay prints "Nightly rates do not include 13.38% room tax", but that page is a Cosmopolitan offer, not Bellagio's own terms, so 13.38% is shown only as the county rate used for an estimate and no true cost is calculated from it.

method: True cost per night is the official booking engine's own checkout total (room charges + resort fee + taxes) divided by the number of nights in that quote. It is filled in only when the property has a dated quote in the rate log, so nothing is reconstructed from an assumed rate: the printed figures are (room + fee) x (1 + verified room tax), and that identity is re-checked for every entry in data/rates.json. data/rates.json keeps every quote separately with its date, room type, occupancy, cancellation terms and source URL.
